from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEPSRecord(BaseModel):
    """Represents the Basic Earnings Per Share data extracted from one financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in this report")
    basic_eps: float | None = Field(description="The reported Basic Earnings Per Share value (negative for loss)")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g., '元'")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024 年第一季度'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    eps_records: list[CompanyEPSRecord]
